name: Misty
description: Misty is a programmable social robot platform with developer tools for creating custom behaviours and interactions with people.

image.alt: Misty social robot with an expressive screen face and a tracked mobile base

zh.alt: Misty 社交机器人，配有表情丰富的屏幕面部和履带式移动底座

zh.description: Misty 是一个可编程社交机器人平台，提供开发工具，可用于创建自定义行为及与人的互动。

name: NAO
description: NAO is a programmable humanoid robot for hands-on learning about robotics through programming and interaction.

image.alt: NAO humanoid robot standing with one hand on its hip
image.credit: SoftBank Robotics, via IEEE Robots Guide

zh.alt: 一台单手叉腰站立的NAO人形机器人
zh.credit: SoftBank Robotics，资料来源：IEEE Robots Guide

zh.description: NAO是一款可编程人形机器人，可通过编程和交互为机器人学习提供实践平台。

name: Pepper
description: Pepper is a humanoid robot designed to interact with people through conversation and body language, share information and assist visitors.

image.alt: Humanoid robot Pepper with a chest-mounted tablet and wheeled mobile base

zh.alt: 人形机器人 Pepper，配有胸前平板电脑和轮式移动底座

zh.description: Pepper是一款人形机器人，旨在通过对话和肢体语言与人互动、分享信息并协助访客。

name: Unitree Robot Dog
description: Unitree's four-legged robots provide an embodied platform for legged movement, navigation and interaction with the physical environment.

image.alt: Unitree Robot Dog, shown in a representative Go2 product image with all four legs visible

zh.alt: Unitree 机器狗，代表性 Go2 产品图片，四条腿均清晰可见

zh.description: Unitree 的四足机器人为足式运动、导航及与物理环境互动提供具身平台。
